news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares rebound sharply, up ~8% Tuesday and extending gains into Wednesday
news.summary: CLPT jumped about 8.3% on Tuesday to roughly $16.43 (prior close $15.17) and kept climbing into Wednesday toward the $17 area, clawing back part of its post-Q2-earnings selloff. Coverage cited a still-bullish analyst backdrop (B. Riley $30, Lake Street $25, Stifel $22 targets) as context for the bounce.

news.headline: MAK Capital discloses increased 7.8% passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One and Michael A. Kaufman reported beneficial ownership of 2,375,861 shares (7.8%), up from 6.3% (1,901,489 shares) disclosed in a May 2026 filing, indicating continued accumulation by the investor.

news.headline: Q2 2026 earnings call: management frames revenue miss as order timing, not weaker demand
news.source: The Motley Fool (Q2 2026 earnings call transcript)
news.summary: On the call, executives attributed the quarter's shortfall to timing of biopharma orders and capital-equipment deals rather than softening demand, pointing to ~60 active biopharma partners and multiple partners getting positive FDA feedback on prospective BLA pathways.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9M (+18% YoY), misses consensus by ~$1.8M, cuts FY2026 guidance to $48-52M
news.summary: Revenue grew 18% year-over-year (including the IRRAflow portfolio) but fell about $1.8M short of the ~$12.7M Street estimate, driven by a 15% decline in Biologics and Drug Delivery revenue; shares fell over 15% after hours as full-year guidance was cut to $48-52 million.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro unveils five-pillar strategy targeting $500 million in long-term annual revenue
news.summary: Alongside Q2 results, management laid out a five-pillar growth plan spanning neurosurgery navigation, biologics/drug delivery, capital equipment, focused ultrasound/robotics, and CAL preclinical services aimed at reaching $500 million in annual revenue long-term.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro congratulates partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT designation for Parkinson's cell therapy sasineprocel
news.summary: Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic cell-replacement therapy delivered via ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the ASPIRO trial, received FDA RMAT designation, giving it eligibility for accelerated approval and priority review.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results; prior-year Q3 report landed Nov 6, 2025, so an early-November 2026 date is likely (est. ~Nov 5) but has not yet been officially announced.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission (Huntington's disease) - key read-through
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans a Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130 gene therapy after FDA agreed its 3-year Phase I/II data could support accelerated approval; AMT-130 is administered via ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical data readouts
catalysts.detail: Company expects roughly 10 partner clinical trial data readouts across its ~60 biopharma partners over the next 18 months, plus 10-15 new trials using ClearPoint technology beginning enrollment.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling preclinical study at CAL
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's first statement-of-work for a GLP-compliant, IND-enabling preclinical study at its newly acquired ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories facility is expected to complete in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene therapy approvals using ClearPoint delivery
catalysts.detail: Management believes additional partner cell and gene therapies delivered via ClearPoint's platform (including programs like uniQure's AMT-130) could reach commercial approval by the end of 2027.

pulse: CLPT has stabilized and is recovering from the steep post-earnings drop that followed the Aug 3 Q2 revenue miss and FY2026 guidance cut to $48-52 million, rallying roughly 8% on Aug 25 and holding gains near the $17 area through Aug 26-27. The bounce is supported by continued institutional accumulation (MAK Capital now at 7.8%) and a broadly bullish analyst base (consensus 'Strong Buy', targets roughly $22-30) betting on the long-term $500M five-pillar strategy and a growing partner pipeline - including uniQure's Q3 2026 AMT-130 BLA filing and Aspen Neuroscience's new RMAT designation - that relies on ClearPoint's delivery platform. Near-term fundamentals remain choppy on order timing, so the stock's recovery still hinges on these partner catalysts landing on schedule.
